verdict.rationale: Railway's Cloud Agents keep coding-agent machines running persistently in the background even after disconnecting, and the built-in Railway Agent can autonomously diagnose failures, create/configure services, and open PRs, plus condition-based Slack/Discord/email alerts run without manual triggering. However, evidence shows these are mostly agent-assisted or chat-triggered rather than fully scheduled/cron-style autonomous workflows, and there's no independent corroboration of unattended background automation reliability. Missing for 10: explicit scheduled/triggered automation framework (e.g. cron jobs), independent hands-on verification of autonomous background runs.
